title: Cerium–quinone redox couples put under scrutiny

synthesis.procedure: Complexes 2 and 3 were obtained in pure form by protonolysis of Ce[N(SiMe3)2]3 (1) with the corresponding silanol. Complex 3 is the new homoleptic tris(triisopropylsiloxy)cerium(III) dimer. No reagent quantity is given in the main text.
synthesis.temperature: −40 °C (storage after concentration); reaction temperature not stated
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated in pure form; single crystals used for the structure in Fig. 1.

synthesis.procedure: Ce[N(SiMe3)2]3 (1) was treated with 0.5 equivalents of tetrachloro-1,4-benzoquinone in toluene/n-hexane. The mixture changed immediately from yellow to dark brown. Recrystallisation from toluene/n-hexane gave the hydroquinolato-bridged complex. The crystalline yield quoted for this silylamide series is 71–90%.

reagents.name: Ce[N(SiMe3)2]3
reagents.amount: not individually quantified; 0.5 equiv quinone relative to 1

properties.summary: Small effective magnetic moment consistent with a formally tetravalent cerium complex, and a UV-Vis LMCT absorption in toluene.

synthesis.procedure: Ce[N(SiMe3)2]3 (1) was treated with 0.5 equivalents of DDQ in toluene/n-hexane, giving an immediate yellow-to-dark-brown colour change. The hydroquinolato-bridged product was isolated by recrystallisation from toluene/n-hexane (series crystalline yield 71–90%).

properties.summary: Formally Ce(IV) complex with a small μeff and toluene UV-Vis bands near 384 and 511 nm; stable in the solid state and in solution.

measurements.name: molar absorptivity
measurements.conditions: toluene; strong band near 500 nm for 4^hq, 4^Cl4hq and 4^ddhq

synthesis.procedure: Ce[N(SiMe3)2]3 (1) was treated with 0.5 equivalents of tetramethyl-1,4-benzoquinone in toluene/n-hexane. Recrystallisation from toluene/n-hexane afforded 4^Me4hq (series crystalline yield 71–90%). The complex slowly decomposes in n-hexane and toluene and rapidly in THF.

properties.summary: Isolated as a Ce(IV) hydroquinolate but unstable; several weaker UV-Vis bands and a slightly higher μeff are associated with redox decomposition toward Ce(III).

synthesis.procedure: Ce[N(SiMe3)2]3 (1) was treated with 0.5 equivalents of 2,5-di-tert-butyl-1,4-benzoquinone in toluene/n-hexane and the product crystallised from toluene/n-hexane (series crystalline yield 71–90%). In C6D6 the complex is in equilibrium with the reactants and is mainly observed as starting materials.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Recrystallisation from toluene/n-hexane; solid-state stability supported by DRIFT.

synthesis.procedure: Ce[N(SiMe3)2]3 (1) was treated with 0.5 equivalents of 1,4-naphthoquinone in toluene/n-hexane. Recrystallisation from toluene/n-hexane gave 4^nhq (series crystalline yield 71–90%). It slowly decomposes in n-hexane and toluene and rapidly in THF.

properties.summary: Unstable formally Ce(IV) naphthohydroquinolate with the largest μeff in the silylamide series and several UV-Vis bands of relatively low intensity.

synthesis.procedure: Cerous siloxide 2 was reacted with 1,4-benzoquinone in THF, changing from colourless to dark purple. The ceric hydroquinolate was isolated by recrystallisation from THF or THF/Et2O. The crystalline yield for the accessible complexes 5 and 6 is 42–71%. The crystal structure is reported as the Me-THF solvate 5^hq·2MeTHF. No numerical reagent amount is given in the main text.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Recrystallisation from THF or THF/Et2O; crystals as 5^hq·2MeTHF.

properties.summary: Ce(IV) siloxide hydroquinolate with a small μeff and toluene UV-Vis maxima at 369 and 622 nm.

synthesis.procedure: Siloxide 2 was reacted with tetrachloro-1,4-benzoquinone in THF (colourless to dark red). Recrystallisation from THF or THF/Et2O gave 5^Cl4hq within the 42–71% crystalline-yield range reported for complexes 5 and 6. No numerical reagent amount is given in the main text.

properties.summary: Formally Ce(IV) chloranil-derived hydroquinolate with μeff 0.54 BM and a toluene absorption maximum at 493 nm.

synthesis.procedure: Siloxide 2 was reacted with DDQ in THF (colourless to dark yellow/orange). The product was isolated by recrystallisation from THF or THF/Et2O (42–71% crystalline yield for the 5/6 series). No numerical reagent amount is given in the main text.

properties.summary: DDQ-derived Ce(IV) siloxide with μeff 0.60 BM and toluene UV-Vis maxima at 384 and 450 nm.

synthesis.procedure: Siloxide dimer 3 was reacted with 1,4-benzoquinone in THF (colourless to dark purple) and the product recrystallised from THF or THF/Et2O (42–71% crystalline yield for complexes 5 and 6). No numerical reagent amount is given in the main text.

properties.summary: Ce(IV) triisopropylsiloxide hydroquinolate; UV-Vis recorded in THF rather than toluene.

synthesis.procedure: Siloxide 3 was reacted with tetrachloro-1,4-benzoquinone in THF (colourless to dark red) and recrystallised from THF or THF/Et2O. No numerical reagent amount is given in the main text.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Recrystallisation from THF or THF/Et2O; structure shown in Fig. 2.

properties.summary: Chloranil-derived Ce(IV) siloxide with the smallest tabulated μeff (0.50 BM) and a toluene absorption at 511 nm.

synthesis.procedure: Siloxide 3 was reacted with DDQ in THF (colourless to dark yellow/orange) and the product recrystallised from THF or THF/Et2O. No numerical reagent amount is given in the main text.

properties.summary: DDQ-derived Ce(IV) triisopropylsiloxide with μeff 0.66 BM and toluene UV-Vis maxima at 381 and 470 nm.

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of siloxide 3 with 2,5-di-tert-butyl-1,4-benzoquinone in THF gave a pale purple mixture. Crystals of 6^tBu2hq were obtained and show the same hydroquinolato-bridged motif. In solution an equilibrium with the reactants is observed, together with dia- and paramagnetic decomposition products. No numerical reagent amount is given in the main text.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals suitable for XRD were obtained; solvent of crystallisation not separately specified beyond the THF reaction medium.

material_class.structural_family: cerous hydroquinolato-bridged dianion with cobaltocenium cations

synthesis.procedure: A THF solution of 4^hq was treated with two equivalents of cobaltocene. The colour changed from dark brown to pale yellow. Crystallisation from concentrated THF-d8 at −40 °C gave light brown crystals of 7. One equivalent of CoCp2 instead gave a 1:1 mixture of 7 and unreacted 4^hq.

properties.summary: 1H NMR of the reaction mixture shows only broadened paramagnetic signals, consistent with Ce(III). No numerical susceptibility or optical band is reported for isolated 7.

source_locations.location: Reduction of silylamide 4^hq with cobaltocene; Scheme 3
Experimental Section, Reduction of 4^hq with cobaltocene

synthesis.procedure: Siloxide 2 was treated with 0.5 equivalents of tetramethyl-1,4-benzoquinone, changing from colourless to light blue. Recrystallisation from THF gave dark blue crystals of cerous semiquinolate 8. Purification is hindered by co-crystallisation with Ce[OSi(OtBu)3]4 formed by ligand redistribution.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Recrystallisation from THF; co-crystallises with Ce[OSi(OtBu)3]4.

properties.summary: Crystalline X-band cw-EPR shows Ce(III) with a pattern assigned to radical–radical π-bonding of the bridging semiquinolates; the same pattern is seen in frozen 2-Me-THF at 77 K.

measurements.name: g_parallel
measurements.conditions: X-band cw-EPR of crystalline 8; also frozen 2-Me-THF at 77 K

synthesis.procedure: Siloxide 3 was treated with 0.5 equivalents of tetramethyl-1,4-benzoquinone (colourless to light blue). Dark blue crystals of 9 were grown by recrystallisation from THF. Co-crystallisation with [Ce(OSi^iPr3)4] impedes purification.

properties.summary: X-band cw-EPR of crystalline 9 is characteristic of Ce(III) (g_parallel about 4.351). An additional g = 1.999 signal is attributed to a non-coupled radical impurity.

measurements.name: g_parallel
measurements.conditions: X-band cw-EPR of crystalline 9; also frozen 2-Me-THF at 77 K

synthesis.procedure: Investigations of cerium pyrazolate/quinone reactions (Me2pz and tBu2pz with benzoquinones) gave product mixtures. Crystallised products include this cerous cluster from partial pyrazolyl-promoted nucleophilic attack, described as Ce3(bpad)(pasq)(Me2pz)6(thf) (bpad = 1,4-bis(3,5-dimethylpyrazol-1-yl)anthra-1,4-diolato; pasq = 1-(3,5-dimethylpyrazol-1-yl)anthra-1,4-semiquinolato), reported as 84% mixed with [Ce(Me2pz)2(thf)2(asq)]. Structural details are referred to the ESI. No numerical reagent amounts are given in the main text. The supplied CCDC formula includes two toluene molecules.

reagents.name: quinone substrate leading to anthra-1,4-diolato/semiquinolato ligands

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallised from the pyrazolate/quinone reaction mixture; CSD formula is the toluene disolvate.
synthesis.yield: 84% (as stated for this crystallised cerous product in a mixture)

synthesis.procedure: Obtained only in minor amounts among products crystallised from cerium 3,5-di-tert-butylpyrazolate reactions with tetramethyl-1,4-benzoquinone. Steric bulk reduces but does not prevent ligand redistribution and product mixtures. No quantities are given in the main text; structural details are referred to the ESI.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Minor crystalline product from the pyrazolate reaction mixture.

synthesis.procedure: Crystallised together with Ce3(bpad)(pasq)(Me2pz)6(thf) from cerium dimethylpyrazolate/quinone reactions. The main text gives no reagent quantities and points to the ESI for structural details. asq is anthrasemiquinolato.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Co-crystallised or mixed with the Ce3 pyrazolyl-anthraquinone cluster.
